Click any empire/country/entity on the map or in the legend for a dossier — key figures, domestic politics, and internal timeline. Map boundaries are approximate and derived from Natural Earth (public domain). Modern country borders are used as rough proxies for pre-1914 imperial territories and do not represent any position on current international boundary disputes. Key differences from 1910: Transylvania (now Romania) was Austria-Hungary; Vojvodina (now Serbia) was Austria-Hungary; Kosovo was Ottoman; Poland was partitioned among Germany, Russia, and Austria-Hungary; Finland and the Baltics were Russian. This is an educational project, not a political statement.
